projectContext: Sprint 17 targets the deepest remaining coverage gaps discovered during sprint 16 analysis: 3 pipeline stages with ZERO dedicated tests (BrollDownloadStage 454 LOC, CaptionStage 1008 LOC, BrollMatchStage 793 LOC), downloader transcoding module (331 LOC, 0 tests), CLI interactive/logging modules (256 LOC combined, 0 tests), APIHealer private error handlers (5 methods tested only indirectly), LLM client private helpers (_normalize_confidence, _is_permanent_error with no unit tests), and config merge duration tier helpers (2 functions with no direct tests). These gaps represent ~2,800 LOC of untested pipeline-critical code handling B-roll workflows, video transcoding, caption fetching, error recovery, and user-facing CLI functionality.
